name: CruiseCabinInventoryAllocator
tagline: Sell, hold and allocate every cabin of a sailing – deck plan, group holds and guarantee upgrades in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete cruise inventory app for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages. See sold %, category cover and expiring holds on the dashboard, work the ship deck by deck, manage group and agency allotments with pickup and release dates, and allocate guarantee bookings by loyalty tier with controlled upgrades. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped and connects to any collection, Dataverse/SharePoint/SQL table or the Power Pages Web API without writing JSON.
features: 8 clickable KPIs: sold %, available, group holds, options, guarantees, expiring holds, blocked, booked revenue
Inventory by category with net availability – covered, covered by upgrades or oversold
Deck plan by deck, side and position with status colours, accessible and expiry flags
Guarantee queue by loyalty tier and booking date with Auto-allocate, Accept all and manager override
Upgrade limit on a configurable category ladder; accessible cabins kept for guests who need them
Group/agency holds with pickup %, release countdown, extend and release unsold
Status rules with required fields, validation, confirmations and undo
Bulk hold, release, block, unblock, export CSV and delete
Move / upgrade a booking to another cabin
27 Power Fx outputs and 6 events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
Phone bottom bar, card list and bottom-sheet dialogs; keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (2 controls: CruiseCabinInventoryAllocator data-set + CruiseCabinInventoryAllocatorPortal field)
